meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 先派子代理去读真实文档和示例、列出确实存在的 API,再输出一份分阶段实施计划:每个阶段写明照着哪个文件写、怎么验证、要避开哪些写法,最后带一个验证阶段。
howto.when: 当你要求为某个功能、任务或多步骤实现做计划时触发;原文还提到在执行(do)之前先做规划。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能做一份分阶段的实施计划
say.note: 它会先查文档再给计划

say.text: 先做文档调研,列出真正可用的 API,再写计划
say.note: 产出含 Allowed APIs 清单

say.text: 给这个计划加一个验证阶段,并列出要避开的写法
say.note: 计划末尾会多一个验证阶段

howto.what_en: Claude sends subagents to read docs and examples and list APIs that actually exist, then writes a phased plan: each phase cites files to copy from, a verification checklist and anti-pattern guards, plus a final verification phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — the description notes especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Write a phased implementation plan for this new feature
say_en.note: It checks docs first, then plans

say_en.text: Do doc discovery first and list the APIs that really exist
Add a verification phase and list anti-patterns to avoid
